text:
Rafi (growth): flagging an oddity in the weekly launch dashboard — a big lift in signups overnight but paid spend flat. can someone pull the hourly and click logs?
June (analytics): pulling Launch > Performance > last 36h. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/launch-overview?range=36h
June (analytics): spike concentrated 02:20-02:55 UTC. impressions x2.1, uniques only +140. click export shows many rows with utm_source=partner_portal but utm_campaign empty.
Omar (ads): we did a partner syndication drop with PortalCo at 02:15 UTC. creative included utm_source=partner_portal and campaign param should be portal_march_launch. if campaign missing, attribution falls back to organic.
Tara (ops): pipeline note from KPIbot: ingest-2026-06-12T02:35Z processed; 64 rows flagged with utm_campaign=null in partition 2026-06-12-02.
Rafi (growth): ok — that would inflate organic numbers and lower apparent paid CVR. operational asks: 1) mark affected leads as "needs-audit" in KPI sheet; 2) annotate dashboard; 3) hold nurture for those IDs until reclass.
June (analytics): will add annotation and mark rows in the weekly KPI spreadsheet. prepping a pre/post CAC calc once rejoin runs.
Tara (ops): creating ticket MKT-7451 "partner_portal missing utm_campaign on redirect" and assigning to eng-redirects. quick mitigation: append campaign server-side on first redirect for partner links. infra ETA 5 hrs.
Omar (ads): can PortalCo's link builder be updated? quick ask to partner to ensure campaign param included. filing partner-ask to PortalCo with sample links.
KPIbot: rejoin job queued: reproc-4109-01 will run after INF-3321 deploy to avoid double-counts.
Rafi (growth): also advise we add a one-line narrative to Friday KPI deck: "06/12 partner syndication drove amplified impressions; missing campaign param caused temporary misattribution; reclassification pending."
June (analytics): noted. i'll compute delta: if 64 leads reclass to paid, estimated CAC for launch cohort +11% (rough). will post exact pre/post when reproc finishes.
Tara (ops): holding nurture and tagging 64 lead IDs with "hold-reclass" in CRM. removing them from the reminder cohort.
Omar (ads): partner notified and asked to republish with full params. also toggling a temporary server-side append for partner_portal hostnames.
Rafi (growth): great — final asks: Tara add dashboard annotation + hold flags; June add pre/post numbers to Friday slides; Omar follow partner fix + infra patch. i'll brief execs in the Friday KPI sync. :white_check_mark:
